shell_sign_in_dialog_description: Sign-in is just for sync. Browse and collect work fine without it. Want your Vault on every device? We'll email a magic link. No password, no snooping.
shell_about_description: Cardstack is a fan-made, open-source collection manager for the Pokémon TCG. Local-first, your data, no ads, no snooping. Built by collectors, with thanks to:
shell_credit_pokemon_body: Pokémon and all related names are trademarks of Nintendo, Creatures Inc., and GAME FREAK inc. Cardstack is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by them.
shell_credit_card_data_body: Every card you browse and collect is sourced from TCGdex, an open, community-run card database. Some set logos and Western pricing come from pokemontcg.io as a fallback.
shell_credit_holo_body: The holo and foil shaders that make the chase cards glint are adapted from Pokémon Cards CSS by Simon Goellner (@simeydotme).
shell_credit_pricing_body: Live market prices come from TCGplayer and Cardmarket, surfaced through the pokemontcg.io pricing fields.
shell_credit_fonts_body: Clash Display by the Indian Type Foundry (via Fontshare), plus Space Grotesk and Geist Mono, both under the SIL Open Font License.
shell_open_source_note: Open source, top to bottom. No landlord, no lock-in.
